concerns.text: Task T005 creates `modeling_config.json` and provides `enforce_gates.py`, but no subsequent task actually executes `enforce_gates.py` before model fitting (T006). This allows the pipeline to proceed to modeling even when `abort_flag` is true, violating the intended data‑flow gate. A dedicated task (e.g., T005a) should run `enforce_gates.py` and abort if needed, placed before T006.
